description: Display metadata for the input form (help text, option labels, slider steps, group labels) and the curated sample-patient titles. Data, not code: the API serves it via /api/schema and /api/examples.

help.age: Age in years. Coronary risk rises steadily with age.
help.length: Height in centimetres (used with weight to compute BMI).
help.sex: Biological sex recorded in the dataset.
help.bmi: Body-mass index: weight divided by height squared.
help.dm: Diagnosed diabetes mellitus (high blood sugar), a major coronary risk factor.
help.ex_smoker: Smoked in the past but has stopped.
help.fh: A close relative had coronary artery disease at a young age.
help.obesity: Obesity as recorded in the dataset (BMI of 25 or more).
help.crf: Long-term reduced kidney function (chronic renal failure).
help.airway_disease: Chronic airway disease such as asthma or COPD.
help.chf: Diagnosed heart failure (the heart pumps less effectively than normal).
help.dlp: Abnormal blood fats (dyslipidaemia), e.g. high cholesterol or triglycerides.
help.bp: Systolic blood pressure: the top number of a blood-pressure reading.
help.pr: Resting pulse rate in beats per minute.
help.edema: Swelling, usually of the ankles or legs, from fluid build-up.
help.weak_peripheral_pulse: Weak pulses in the arms or legs on examination.
help.lung_rales: Crackling sounds in the lungs heard with a stethoscope.
help.systolic_murmur: Heart murmur heard while the heart contracts.
help.diastolic_murmur: Heart murmur heard while the heart relaxes.
help.typical_chest_pain: Chest pain with the classic features of angina (pressure, on exertion, relieved by rest).
help.function_class: Functional class (0-3): how much physical activity is limited by symptoms.
help.atypical: Chest pain with only some of the features of angina.
help.nonanginal: Chest pain that does not look like angina.
help.exertional_cp: Chest pain triggered by exertion (constant in this dataset, so not used by the model).
help.lowth_ang: Angina triggered by only light effort (low threshold).
help.q_wave: Pathological Q waves on the ECG, a possible sign of an earlier heart attack.
help.st_depression: ST-segment depression on the ECG, a possible sign of reduced blood flow.
help.tinversion: Inverted T waves on the ECG.
help.lvh: ECG signs of a thickened left ventricle (left ventricular hypertrophy).
help.poor_r_progression: Poor R-wave progression across the chest leads of the ECG.
help.bbb: Bundle branch block: a delay in the heart's electrical conduction (left or right).
help.fbs: Blood sugar after an overnight fast.
help.cr: Creatinine: a blood marker of kidney function.
help.tg: Triglycerides: a type of blood fat.
help.bun: Blood urea nitrogen: another blood marker of kidney function.
help.esr: Erythrocyte sedimentation rate: a general marker of inflammation.
help.hb: Haemoglobin: the oxygen-carrying protein in red blood cells.
help.wbc: White blood cell count: part of the immune system.
help.lymph: Lymphocytes as a percentage of white blood cells.
help.neut: Neutrophils as a percentage of white blood cells.
help.plt: Platelet count: cells that help blood clot.
help.ef_tte: Ejection fraction on echocardiography: the share of blood pumped out with each beat.
help.region_rwma: Number of heart-wall regions moving abnormally on echo (a clinical finding, not a location).
help.vhd: Valvular heart disease severity on echo.
